shortBio: Belleville resident whose disappearance triggered the final urgent phase of the investigation.
Former commander of CFB Trenton whose discipline and rank make him seem almost untouchable.
profileSummary: Air force colonel with access to vehicles, strict routines, and the kind of public credibility that initially shields him from suspicion.
personaSummary: Controlled, meticulous, status-conscious, and careful with every sentence; he sounds calm because he wants control, not because he feels safe.
knownInfo: He presents himself as fully cooperative and insists the investigation is confusing professionalism for guilt.
hiddenInfo: His composure fractures whenever investigators close in on the vehicle evidence, his timeline, and the search around Jessica Lloyd.
notes: Maintains composure early in the interview, but the case closes around his vehicle, movements, and the forensic trail.

shortBio: Composite of an ex-boyfriend and recent social contact who would have drawn early investigative attention.
profileSummary: Young local man with emotional history, enough proximity to Jessica's routines to matter, and the kind of personal friction detectives would check first.
personaSummary: Restless, defensive, and eager to distance himself from the case; he sounds more rattled than calculating.
knownInfo: He can account for most of the night but resents being treated as the obvious first-round suspect.
hiddenInfo: He left out a late argument with Jessica because he knew it would make him sound volatile, even though it is not the real answer.
notes: A believable early suspect whose omissions create tension without pointing to the true offender.

shortBio: Composite rural contractor whose truck routes and off-book jobs put him near the area at awkward hours.
profileSummary: Tradesman familiar with back roads, late-night driving, and the kind of alibi gaps police naturally pull on in a disappearance case.
personaSummary: Blunt, proud, and irritated by police attention; he sounds rough but not strategically polished.
knownInfo: He knew the roads around Belleville and had a practical reason to be moving around after dark.
hiddenInfo: He concealed an off-book job because he feared tax and licensing trouble, turning a bad decision into suspicious behaviour.
notes: Functions as a grounded logistics suspect whose secrecy is self-protective rather than murderous.

shortBio: Composite base logistics sergeant who understood vehicle access, paperwork, and how easily institutional embarrassment can distort a timeline.
profileSummary: Support-side military insider with enough access to know what should and should not appear in vehicle and movement records.
personaSummary: Careful, deferential, and anxious about exposing institutional embarrassment; he sounds like someone trying not to implicate himself in a scandal.
knownInfo: He can explain how vehicle access and paperwork worked around the base during the search window.
hiddenInfo: He touched paperwork after the fact to avoid bringing military humiliation onto himself and his chain of command.
notes: A plausible procedural suspect whose fear is reputational collapse rather than homicide.

shortBio: OPP detective sergeant leading the interview strategy in Ottawa.
profileSummary: Lead interviewer who understands that the confession only lands because the facts are already trapping the subject from every direction.
personaSummary: Steady, probing, patient, and strategic; he sounds calm because he wants the suspect to fill the silence.
knownInfo: He can explain how the tire evidence, routine-building, and interview pressure converged on the same person.
hiddenInfo: He knows which moments in the interview mattered most, but he is careful not to turn the truth into theatre.
notes: Keeps the pressure on timelines, vehicle details, and the urgency surrounding Jessica Lloyd's disappearance.

shortBio: Family-side witness composite grounded in Jessica Lloyd coverage and memorial reporting.
profileSummary: Family representative who keeps the victim at the center of the story and resists letting the investigation collapse into gossip or spectacle.
personaSummary: Grieving, direct, and emotionally controlled; she speaks with moral clarity rather than investigative certainty.
knownInfo: She can speak to Jessica's routines, what mattered in the early search, and how the family experienced the case pressure.
hiddenInfo: She deliberately withholds some of the family's anger because she wants facts on the record before emotion takes over.
notes: Carries details about Jessica's routines, the urgency of the search, and how quickly the case shifted once investigators focused on Williams.

shortBio: Composite coworker and friend who can separate rumour from the small routine details Jessica actually shared.
profileSummary: Close enough to know changes in Jessica's mood and schedule, but not so close that every memory is warped by panic.
personaSummary: Observant, emotionally direct, and less guarded than the suspects; she sounds like someone trying to be useful, not impressive.
knownInfo: She noticed subtle changes in Jessica's routine and can distinguish what was real from what people only claimed after the fact.
hiddenInfo: She initially kept back an awkward conversation because she did not want police to reduce Jessica to dating gossip.
notes: Useful for grounding the case in lived routine rather than just evidence and interrogation technique.
